feedback: We urgently need SSO single sign-on to close the enterprise Acme deal this quarter.
SSO is risky and complex; it requires six weeks of effort and a brittle auth rewrite.
SSO is a critical strategic priority for moving upmarket into larger accounts.
Please add dark mode; our users love it and it would add great value for night reading.
Dark mode is hard to maintain and could break accessibility; it feels fragile to ship.
Dark mode keeps coming up on sales calls as an important differentiator for night users.
